run_PowerTransformer_box_cox: run PowerTransformer with method box-cox to map non-normal data to a normal distribution
run_PowerTransformer_yeo_johnson: run PowerTransformer with method yeo-johnson to map data with negative values to a normal distribution
run_QuantileTransformer_normal: run QuantileTransformer with output_distribution normal to force any distribution into a gaussian
build_distribution_samples: build sample datasets from lognormal, chi-squared, weibull, gaussian, uniform, and bimodal distributions
test_transform_comparison: test Box-Cox, Yeo-Johnson, and QuantileTransformer transformations on the same dataset
